 LIVE 4th T20I Updates: India recover slightly after losing Samson, Ishan
   Fri, 30 October 2026 
 Refresh   
 14:59 
 4th T20I Updates: India recover slightly after losing Samson, Ishan 
 India 27-2 (3 Ovs) vs NZ 259-7 | SCORECARD Adam Milne comes on from the other end. Abhishek Sharma clips the ball towards fine leg for a couple of runs to get off the mark. He then whips it over midwicket, but Smith gets across to keep it down to two. New Zealand's bowlers are keeping the ball wide of Abhishek, making him reach for his shots. He misses a flick at a slightly wide delivery and the ball deflects off his pad for a single.
Shreyas Iyer takes a quick single, but a direct hit at the striker's end makes it a close call. Abhishek finishes the over with a boundary. Ten runs come off it as India reach 18/2 after two overs.
Jacob Duffy continues. Iyer clips the first delivery behind square for a single. Abhishek shuffles across and has a tentative waft at the next ball, but extra bounce takes it over his edge. A tough chance goes begging as Santner fails to hold on. Abhishek gets two runs. Another misfield gifts him a boundary.
He defends the next delivery before hopping inside the line and guiding the ball towards fine leg for a couple. Nine runs come off the over. India are 27/2 after three overs, needing 233 more runs.
 14:44 
 4th T20I Updates: Double blow for India; Duffy removes Ishan, Sanju 
 India 8-2 (1 Ovs) vs NZ 259-7 |  SCORECARD 
 Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma are at the crease, with Samson on strike as Jacob Duffy takes the new ball.
Samson gets India off the mark in style, cracking the opening delivery for a boundary. But Duffy strikes back immediately! Samson looks to attack again but finds Tim Seifert, who takes a safe catch behind the stumps.
A big early breakthrough for New Zealand as Samson departs for 4 off just two balls. An unusually early setback for India in this series. 
 Ishan Kishan is the new batter. He pushes the ball back down the pitch and Duffy dives to stop it. Kishan then looks to steer the next delivery towards third man but is beaten by the outside edge.  
 OUT! Caught and bowled!  
 Duffy takes a sharp return catch to send Kishan back for a duck off three balls. India have lost two wickets early in the chase. 
 Shreyas Iyer is the new batter and gets off the mark with a boundary. India end the first over at 8/2, having lost two wickets. 
 14:27 
 4th T20I Updates: Phillips' 107 powers NZ to 259 
 NZ 259-7 (20 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD India have been penalised for a slow over-rate, adding to their woes after a difficult outing with the ball.
Nitish Kumar Reddy takes responsibility for the final over, with Nathan Smith the new batter. Phillips wastes no time, launching the first delivery over the ropes for another six. But Nitish strikes back immediately as Abhishek Sharma takes a catch to end a sensational innings.
Phillips walks back to a standing ovation after a breathtaking 107 off just 49 balls. What a knock!
Adam Milne joins Smith and gets off the mark with a single. Smith then flicks the ball towards deep midwicket for two more runs. Nitish pulls out of his delivery as he spots Smith setting up for the scoop.
Smith misses the next attempt, but finishes the innings with a boundary off an outside edge.
Thirteen runs come off the final over as New Zealand post a formidable 259/7 in 20 overs.
 14:20 
 4th T20I Updates: Phillips' century lights up Auckland 
 NZ 246-6 (19 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Arshdeep Singh returns for his final over and begins with a couple of wides. Phillips leaves the next three deliveries before getting enough bat on the ball to steer it through cover-point for two runs.
He then unleashes a massive six to bring up a magnificent century off just 46 balls! What a knock from the New Zealand star. Phillips takes a single off the next delivery, while Santner adds two more.
A rare dot ball follows before Arshdeep finishes the over with a crucial wicket. The wide yorker does the trick as Santner fails to get it away and Nitish Reddy takes the catch.
Santner departs for 5 off 6 balls. Nine runs and a wicket come off the over. New Zealand are 246/6 after 19 overs.
 14:10 
 4th T20I Updates: Bracewell's 6-hitting blitz ends as Prince strikes 
 NZ 232-5 (18 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Mayank Yadav is back into the attack, but Michael Bracewell continues his assault, launching another six to make it five consecutive maximums for New Zealand! He brings up a superb half-century in the process.
Bracewell is struck on the thigh pad off the next delivery before sending another one sailing over the ropes. He collects two more runs and then launches yet another six. That's seven sixes in the last nine balls! Mayank manages to finish the over with a yorker outside off, but another 20 runs come off it.
New Zealand race to 226/4 after 17 overs.
Prince Yadav takes over from the other end. Phillips gets a single off the first delivery before India finally find a breakthrough.
Bracewell is given out LBW and immediately opts for a review after a brief discussion with Phillips. The replays show no bat or glove involved, and the decision stands.
A much-needed wicket for India as the dangerous Bracewell departs after a stunning 65 off just 25 balls. The 100-plus partnership is broken, giving India some relief after a brutal assault from the New Zealand pair. 
 Mitchell Santner is the new batter and gets off the mark with a couple of runs. He then throws his bat at a drive but fails to make contact. The next delivery is just inside the wide marker, allowing Santner to collect a single. 
 A delivery that sails well above the batter's head is called a wide for height. A single off the final ball brings the over to an end. 
 Six runs come off it. New Zealand are 232/5 after 18 overs. 
 14:00 
 4th T20I Updates: Phillips unleashes 6-hitting blitz to take NZ past 200 
 Nitish Reddy returns to the attack and India immediately go up for an LBW appeal against Bracewell. Nitish is convinced and has a word with wicketkeeper Ishan Kishan, but the review goes against India as they lose a review.
Bracewell had shuffled across and crouched low to play the scoop, getting an under-edge onto his pad before the ball rolled towards fine leg.
Glenn Phillips then takes charge, smashing a boundary before a no-ball adds to India's woes. He squeezes the next delivery towards deep backward point and races back for two.
What follows is a stunning assault! Phillips launches three consecutive sixes, taking New Zealand past the 200-run mark. He isn't done yet, adding another maximum to cap a massive over.
A staggering 32 runs come off it! New Zealand race to 206/4 after 16 overs.
 13:56 
 4th T20I Updates: Bracewell goes berserk as India pay for costly miss 
 NZ 174-4 (15 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Axar Patel returns to the attack, but Michael Bracewell gives him a brutal welcome, smashing back-to-back boundaries. He follows it up with a huge six and another four! Bracewell is taking the attack to the Indian spinner.
He then slaps one in front of square for a single before offering India a chance. The ball goes high in the air and Naman Dhir charges in from long-off, but completely misjudges it and fails to get anywhere near the catch. A costly miss? India will hope not!
Twenty runs come off the over as New Zealand race to 167/4 after 14 overs.
Arshdeep Singh is back into the attack. Phillips reaches out and guides a single towards long-off, while Bracewell gets another run with a slice towards deep backward point. Arshdeep then strays down the leg side for a wide.
Phillips gets another single, but there is a close run-out chance when a direct hit catches him short of his ground. The remaining deliveries bring more singles.
Seven runs come off the over. New Zealand are 174/4 after 15 overs.
 13:43 
 4th T20I Updates: Glenn Phillips blazes his 3rd fifty of the series 
 NZ 147-4 (13 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Naman Dhir is brought into the attack, but the New Zealand batters take him on. Bracewell punches the first delivery towards backward point but finds no run. He makes up for it with a boundary off the next ball before taking a single to long-off.
Phillips gets down on one knee and nails a slog sweep over midwicket for four. He follows it up with a single before Bracewell finishes the over in style, launching a huge six!
A big over for New Zealand as 16 runs come off it. The hosts move to 129/4 after 12 overs.
Prince Yadav returns to the attack, but Phillips is in no mood to slow down. He collects two runs to bring up his third half-century of the series! He celebrates the milestone by smashing the next delivery for a six.
Phillips then pulls one towards deep square leg for a single, before Bracewell joins the big-hitting party with a six of his own. He collects two more runs and takes a single off the final delivery.
Another expensive over for India, with 18 runs coming off it. New Zealand race to 147/4 after 13 overs.
 13:35 
 4th T20I Updates: Mayank Yadav strikes again, Jacobs falls 
 NZ 113-4 (11 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Mayank Yadav returns after the drinks break and immediately puts Phillips under pressure, beating him with a delivery as the batter swings and misses. Phillips then moves across to access the leg side but manages only a single, with leg-byes called.
Bevon Jacobs picks up a couple of runs off the next delivery but Mayank has the last laugh! The pacer uses his pace and bounce to good effect once again, forcing Jacobs into a mistimed pull. The ball takes the top edge and Arshdeep Singh makes no mistake at midwicket.
That's Mayank's third wicket of the innings! Jacobs departs for 7, failing to extend his impressive run of three successive 30-plus scores.
Michael Bracewell is the new batter and gets off the mark with a single. Phillips swings hard at the next delivery but fails to make contact.
Just four runs and a wicket come off the over. New Zealand are 113/4 after 11 overs, with India firmly back in control. 
 13:31 
 4th T20I Updates: Phillips powers New Zealand past 100 
 NZ 109-3 (10 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Nitish continues, and Phillips uses the open face of the bat to guide the ball towards point for a single.
Auckland-born Bevon Jacobs is out in the middle for his first taste of international cricket at his home ground. He gets off the mark with a single.
Phillips then picks up the ball and launches it over midwicket, using the wind to good effect. New Zealand cross the 100-run mark in style! He follows it up with another single as the batters rotate the strike through the rest of the over.
Eleven runs come off it. New Zealand are 104/3 after nine overs.
Axar continues, and Phillips defends before picking up a single after Shreyas Iyer fails to collect the ball cleanly. Jacobs drives towards extra cover but finds no gap. He gets off the mark with another single off the next delivery. The batters keep the scoreboard ticking with singles.
Five runs come off the over. New Zealand are 109/3 after 10 overs.
With two in-form batters at the crease, the hosts will be looking to build a strong partnership and push towards a total in excess of 200.
 13:20 
 4th T20I Updates: Axar strikes after Allen's explosive 31 off 17 balls 
 NZ 93-3 (8 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Nitish Kumar Reddy comes into the attack. Allen gets an inside edge onto his pad before picking up a single off the next delivery. He then frees his arms to smash a boundary and follows it up with two more runs to close the over. There is a strong breeze blowing across the stadium.
Eight runs come off the over. New Zealand are 75/2 after seven overs.
Axar Patel is introduced into the attack, but Allen welcomes him with a boundary, followed by back-to-back sixes! The New Zealand opener is in full flow as he takes the attack to the Indian spinner.
The batters exchange singles before Axar has the last laugh. Allen looks to clear the off-side but fails to get the required elevation. Abhishek Sharma takes the catch and Axar celebrates the big wicket.
Allen departs for a blazing 31 off 17 balls. Eighteen runs and a big wicket come off the over as New Zealand reach 93/3 after eight overs. 
 13:09 
 4th T20I Updates: NZ hit back as Phillips takes charge 
 NZ 67-2 (6 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Arshdeep Singh continues,  Allen guides the ball towards third man for a single.
Phillips defends the next delivery off the back foot.
 Phillips finds the fielder at cover-point again. No run this time.
 But you can't keep the in-form batter quiet for long! Phillips launches the next delivery over the ropes for a huge six.
He follows it up with a quick single. Arshdeep has a chance to run out the non-striker with a direct hit, but misses the opportunity.
 A dot ball brings the over to an end. Eight runs come off it. New Zealand are 53/2 after five overs.
Prince Yadav continues, Phillips defends the first delivery before swinging and missing at the next.
He makes no mistake when he connects, though, sending the ball soaring over the boundary for a six!
A slight fumble from Shreyas Iyer gives the batters a chance for a single, but they decide against taking the risk.
Phillips finishes the over in style with back-to-back boundaries.
Fourteen runs come off the over as New Zealand race to 67/2 at the end of the powerplay. 
 12:52 
 4th T20I Updates: Mitchell's 6-hitting spree ends as Mayank strikes back 
 NZ 45-2 (4 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD Mayank Yadav continues and Daryl Mitchell makes his intentions clear straightaway, welcoming the pacer with back-to-back sixes!
Mitchell, who has been consistent throughout the series, frees his arms and takes full advantage of the width, smashing the next delivery for four. He follows it up with another cracking boundary in the same area. A whopping 20 runs come off the first four balls of the over!
But Mayank hits back in style. A loud appeal for LBW follows, and the umpire raises his finger. Mitchell opts for a review, but the replays confirm there was no bat involved and the ball was hitting the stumps. He has to walk back after a blazing 24 off just nine balls.
A dramatic comeback from Mayank after being taken for plenty! 
 Glenn Phillips is the new batter as Prince Yadav comes into the attack. 
 Finn Allen stands tall and pushes the ball towards mid-on for a quick single. 
 -Phillips gets off the mark in style, finding the boundary with a crisp shot. That's a confident start from the in-form batter! 
 Allen rocks back and works the ball away for a single. 
 Allen follows it up with a superb boundary, sending the ball racing away after one bounce. 
 Phillips takes a single with another back-foot shot before the over ends with a dot ball. 
 Ten runs come off the over. New Zealand are 45/2 after four overs. 
 12:45 
 4th T20I Updates: Mayank, Prince combine to send Seifert packing 
 NZ 14-1 (2 Ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Daryl Mitchell is the new batter, while Arshdeep Singh takes the ball from the other end. He begins with a wide, which Ishan Kishan, wearing the wicketkeeping gloves today, dives to his right to collect. 
 No swing on offer this time as Allen works the ball through square leg for a single. Mitchell gets off the mark with a gentle tuck towards backward square leg for one. Allen goes after the next delivery, but the slow outfield denies him a boundary. Prince Yadav does well to chase it down and keep it to three runs. 
 Mitchell pulls an uppish delivery towards deep square leg, where Mayank Yadav runs across to stop the ball. The batters collect two. 
 Mitchell defends the next delivery before taking a single to end the over. 
 Nine runs come off the over. New Zealand are 14/1 after two overs. 
 12:39 
 4th T20I Updates: Mayank, Prince combine to send Seifert packing 
 NZ 5-1 (1 Ovs) vs India |  SCORECARD 
 Tim Seifert and Finn Allen are at the crease, with Seifert on strike as Mayank Yadav takes the new ball.
Mayank starts with a fuller delivery and Seifert gets off the mark with a single towards cover.
Allen defends the next delivery towards backward point.
Mayank gets some outswing outside off and Allen throws his bat at it. He gets a thick edge that flies towards third man, where Prince Yadav moves across and takes the catch but fails to hold on. The siren goes off for a no-ball.
The outfield looks a little slow as Tilak Varma chases the ball towards the boundary. Seifert collects two runs.
Seifert keeps the next delivery down for no run.
Seifert mistimes his shot and this time Prince Yadav makes no mistake, completing the catch. Seifert departs for 3 off 5 balls.
 12:08 
 4th T20I Updates: India opt to bowl, bring in Ishan and Mayank 
 Here are the playing XIs
New Zealand: Finn Allen, Tim Seifert(w), Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Bevon Jacobs, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner(c), Nathan Smith, Adam Milne, Jacob Duffy, Matthew Fisher
 India: Abhishek Sharma, Sanju Samson(w), Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer(c), Tilak Varma, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Naman Dhir, Axar Patel, Arshdeep Singh, Mayank Yadav, Prince Yadav 
 12:03 
 4th T20I Updates: India opt to bowl, bring in Ishan and Mayank 
 Shreyas Iyer has opted to bowl after winning the toss.
 India have made two changes, bringing in Ishan Kishan for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Mayank Yadav in place of Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
 Shreyas Iyer: We're going to bowl first and stick to the same approach. It's important to be ruthless, and that's the message we've given the boys. Everyone is in good spirits. We expect some bounce and seam movement. We have made two changes, with Ishan Kishan coming in for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Mayank Yadav replacing Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
 Mitchell Santner: It's a fresh start for us. The pitch tends to offer a little more bounce here, but it looks like a good batting surface.
 11:59 
 India set to experiment after sealing NZ series 
 With the series already in the bag, India have the luxury of experimenting when they take on New Zealand in the fourth T20I in Auckland on Friday.  
 The focus could shift from winning to giving some of the players on the sidelines a chance to prove themselves, with wrist spinners Kuldeep Yadav and Varun Chakaravarthy among those waiting for an opportunity.
India's 3-0 lead gives the team management room to tinker with the winning combination, especially after three high-scoring games in which the visitors have backed a deep batting line-up. But with only two matches left, the likes of Kuldeep and Varun will be keen to get some valuable game time before the team moves on.
Kuldeep, in particular, will be eager to get back into the playing XI. The left-arm wrist spinner has repeatedly shown his ability to break partnerships and pick up wickets in the middle overs, but has been overlooked for the first three matches.
Varun, meanwhile, has had an inconsistent run over the past six months and will also be looking to make the most of any opportunity that comes his way.
There could be changes in the pace attack too, with Mayank Yadav potentially getting another look-in after Prince Yadav impressed in the last two games. Bhuvneshwar Kumar, meanwhile, will be keen to build on his improved showing at the death in Wellington.
Ishan Kishan's availability remains uncertain after he missed the last two games with a groin injury. If he is still unavailable, young Vaibhav Sooryavanshi could get another chance to showcase his explosive hitting.
With the series decided, India could also consider resting Nitish Reddy, opening the door for Shivam Dube. The fourth T20I offers an ideal opportunity to test the bench strength without losing sight of preparations for the bigger challenges ahead.
